description: Create an automation (action rule) of a form. It runs on_create / on_update and does: send_email, send_sms, update_record, redirect, show_message — or, with do_not_send_data_if_criteria_matches, REFUSES the record. It can carry conditions and the fields to set (update_fields). The answer's `page` is the address of the page that lists this table's automations: give the person that address, never one you compose.

conditions.description: Conditions under which the rule fires

condition.description: is, is_not, contains, is_empty, is_not_empty, less_than, greater_than and so on

do_not_send_data_if_criteria_matches.description: true = when the conditions match, the record is NOT saved and the person filling in the form reads `message` instead (the automation page's «Do not submit data to table if criteria matches»). For «do not accept / refuse / block a submission when …». Needs conditions.

email_column.description: Name or ID of the field with the recipient's email

emails.description: Addresses the mail always goes to, comma-separated. "me" = the person you are talking to (their own account's address): «email me», «notify me», «let me know» — never ask them for it. The answer's emails says the address it became

message.description: The text the person reads: after the save (show_message) or instead of it (do_not_send_data_if_criteria_matches)

numbers.description: Written phone numbers the text always goes to, comma-separated — only when it is NOT a number from the record

on_create.description: Fires when a record is created

on_update.description: Fires when a record is updated

show_message.description: Show `message` AFTER the record is saved. It refuses nothing.

sms_column.description: Where the text goes when each record has its own number: the name or id of the field of this form that holds the phone (the client's phone). Use this for «text the client».

name: create_action_rule
